document.id: Pueblo de San Ildefonso Council Res. No. SI-R26-011
document.heading: PUEBLO DE SAN ILDEFONSO COUNCIL RESOLUTION NO. SI-R26-011
Housing Authority Act Amendments of 2026
document.preamble: At a duly called meeting of the Council of San Ildefonso Pueblo on the 25th day of June, 2026, the following resolution was adopted:

recital.text: the Pueblo de San Ildefonso ("Pueblo") is a sovereign and self-governing Tribe, recognized as such by the United States of America; and
the Council of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso is vested with the authority to make and pass laws by the governing Agreement of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso; and,

the Council has become aware of the need to clarify certain authorities that the Council had delegated to the San Ildefonso Housing Authority ("SIHA") in the Pueblo's Housing Authority Act relating to the authority of SIHA to approve tribal leasehold mortgages; and,
the Council now deems it necessary and proper to amend those provisions of the Pueblo's Housing Authority Act to clarify and reaffirm SIHA's delegated authority to approve tribal leasehold mortgages.
that the Council hereby enacts the attached law entitled the "HOUSING AUTHORITY ACT AMENDMENTS OF 2026".

procedural-data.text: The foregoing resolution was duly voted upon by the Council on June 25, 2026, at a meeting with a vote of 6 in favor, 0 opposed, 2 abstaining and 2 absent (Governor presiding and not voting) pursuant to the authority vested in the Council by the Agreement of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso.

text.strong: DELIVERY OF THE RESOLUTION TO THE GOVERNOR:

procedural-data.text: Resolution No. SI-R26-011 was presented to the Governor of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso on the 26th day of June, 2026, pursuant to the governing Agreement of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso ("Agreement"), GOVERNOR, Sec. 4(c), and will become effective after signature by the Governor or veto override by the Council.

attachment.heading: THE HOUSING AUTHORITY ACT AMENDMENTS OF 2026

section.heading: Short Title
section.text: This enactment shall be known as the "Housing Authority Act Amendments of 2026" ("Act")

section.heading: Purpose
section.text: The purpose of this Act is to amend certain provisions of the Pueblo's Housing Authority Act to reaffirm and clarify the authority delegated by the Council to the San Ildefonso Housing Authority ("SIHA") to establish a leasing process and to approve residential leases and leasehold mortgages.

section.heading: Findings
section.text: The Council hereby finds and declares that:

para.text: the Council has become aware of the need to clarify certain authorities that the Council had delegated to the San Ildefonso Housing Authority ("SIHA") in the Pueblo's Housing Authority Act relating to the authority of SIHA to approve tribal leasehold mortgages.
the Council now deems it necessary and proper to amend those provisions of the Pueblo's Housing Authority Act to clarify and reaffirm SIHA's delegated authority to approve tribal leasehold mortgages.
Section 15.1.8.070 Powers is hereby amended to read:
Powers. The Authority shall have the following powers:

To approve, on behalf of the Pueblo, Leases of and Leasehold Interests in Restricted Land or Trust Land subject to the jurisdiction of the Pueblo, and to manage, on behalf of the Pueblo, the process by which a Member of the Pueblo may obtain Leases of and Leasehold Interests in Restricted Land or Trust Land subject to the jurisdiction of the Pueblo, and the process by which a Member of the Pueblo may Mortgage such Leasehold Interests. The Authority is hereby authorized to promulgate rules and regulations utilizing notice and comment rulemaking for the purpose of carrying out the duties prescribed by this subsection. As used in this subsection, the terms "Lease," "Member," "Mortgage," "Restricted Land," and Trust Land" have the definitions given to them in Section 15.3.1.010 of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso Code.

To approve, on behalf of the Pueblo, Leases of and Leasehold Interests in Restricted Land or Trust Land subject to the jurisdiction of the Pueblo, and to manage, on behalf of the Pueblo, the process by which a Member of the Pueblo may obtain Leases of and Leasehold Interests in Restricted Land or Trust Land subject to the jurisdiction of the Pueblo, and the process by which a Member of the Pueblo may Mortgage such Leasehold Interests. The Authority is hereby authorized to promulgate rules and regulations utilizing notice and comment rulemaking for the purpose of carrying out the duties prescribed by this subsection. As used in this subsection, the terms "Lease," "Member," "Mortgage," "Restricted Land," and Trust Land" have the definitions given to them in Section 15.3.1.010 of the Pueblo de San Ildefonso Code.
This Act and any amendments thereto shall take effect on the date enacted by the Council.
